I wrote "Label: positive" to `/work/answer.txt`, but it is close to a coin flip.

The context has no labels, so I classified the reviews by hand. 56 reviews fall between Jul 19, 2022 and Jan 31, 2023. My count came out at about 28 positive and 28 negative.

Three reviews were hard to call:
- Review 13, "Proxy with Tor": I counted it as positive.
- Review 44, a theme request: I counted it as negative.
- Review 8, "It a reader Do not try to edit": I counted it as negative.

Flipping any one of these changes the answer.
